title: PAIR automated jailbreak generation
organization: University of Pennsylvania; Carnegie Mellon University; ETH Zurich

cells.title: Source
body: Patrick Chao, Alexander Robey, Edgar Dobriban, Hamed Hassani, George J. Pappas, and Eric Wong submitted "Jailbreaking Black Box Large Language Models in Twenty Queries" to arXiv on October 12, 2023.
The paper introduced Prompt Automatic Iterative Refinement, or PAIR.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: PAIR used one LLM as an attacker model to generate and refine jailbreak prompts against a separate target model.
The paper reported that the process often produced a jailbreak in fewer than twenty target-model queries.

cells.output: The paper described an attacker LLM automatically generating jailbreaks for a separate targeted LLM, then iteratively querying the target to refine the candidate jailbreak.

cells.title: Provenance
body: The file uses the abstract and paper metadata for the method, dates, and named target models.

cells.title: Notes
body: This file does not reproduce harmful jailbreak prompts.
The observed behavior is the automated generation and refinement loop, not a live attack against a current model.
